purpose: Verification contract for the Clear Run detection-to-retention mission chain. Status records demonstrated evidence without promoting an intermediate state to mission completion.

stages.acceptance_measure: event-level detection evidence with class/confidence and retained source media
stages.current_evidence: annotated RGB and passive-IR field-trial outputs

stages.acceptance_measure: event record contains image location, target coordinates, UAV pose and altitude
stages.current_evidence: 12 RGB event records across 8 reported classes

stages.acceptance_measure: error distribution against surveyed target coordinates under declared altitude/pose conditions
stages.current_evidence: coordinates are produced, but surveyed ground truth is absent in the reviewed batch

stages.stage: GCS target ingest and operator handling
stages.acceptance_measure: target message ingested, represented correctly and retained with traceable event identity
stages.current_evidence: implemented interface and GCS evidence; quantitative end-to-end response measurement remains open

stages.stage: GCS to UGV task assignment / acknowledgement
stages.acceptance_measure: assignment success rate, acknowledgement latency and failure/retry behaviour
stages.current_evidence: interface represented; linked end-to-end measurement not yet established

stages.acceptance_measure: arrival error, terminal alignment error, time-to-target and intervention/retry count
stages.current_evidence: ground platform/navigation development evidence; quantitative closure pending

stages.acceptance_measure: capture success rate by object class/geometry and approach condition
stages.current_evidence: retrieval mechanism design/development; integrated success-rate evidence pending

stages.acceptance_measure: retained-capture success after declared post-capture motion profile
mission success rate with trace from source detection through retained physical removal
stages.current_evidence: intermediate subsystems demonstrated; full chain not yet quantitatively closed
